semantic_review.reviewer_basis: Reviewed the one-pin source diff, exact maintainer target diff, cutoff tox.ini command provenance, installed-version probes, and both tests' three-arm logs; both selectors independently produced 0/1/0, and the repair changes production retry-statistics lookup without deleting or skipping tests.
semantic_review.source_effect: The opening source change updates the only changed upper-constraints pin from tenacity 8.3.0 to 8.5.0, whose decorated-function wrapper exposes current retry statistics on the function rather than the prior retry controller location used by Octavia.
semantic_review.target_repair: The exact maintainer patch applies to the public opening-cutoff Octavia snapshot and reads statistics from each decorated execute function, retaining an AttributeError compatibility fallback to execute.retry.statistics in both compute and network deletion tasks.
